figurative_meaning_en: Describing someone with mischievous or unruly behavior like a monkey, used as a reproach
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় বাঁদরের মতো দৌড়ে বেড়ায়।
বাঁদর ছেলে, এত শোরগোল করিস না!
example_sentences_in_english: He always runs around like a monkey.
You monkey boy, stop making so much noise!
note: Commonly used in informal Bengali speech to scold naughty children or playful adults
